rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-27 - pertanyaan-tentang-repo-topgrade [ses_f1abaa5fcffe4Rd0iFGEFbqZqE].md:L1817] pacdiff runs sudo --preserve-env=DIFFPROG pacdiff and opens an interactive diff tool, which would hang in a non-tty shell, so config_update was disabled and the pacnew handled by hand

[05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-27 - pertanyaan-tentang-repo-topgrade [ses_f1abaa5fcffe4Rd0iFGEFbqZqE].md:L3917] The .pacnew lacks [cachyos-v3] and [cachyos] and comments out [multilib], so copying it over pacman.conf would delete the CachyOS repos and disable multilib; the existing comment block already recorded that decision
